QuestInfo.name: Trials on the Path
QuestInfo.0: After agreeing with Feng, Xiao Xiao seems lost in thought. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1:
Xiao Xiao said that she wants to accept students in accordance to the Xuanshan School's traditions.
You should prepare the Path of Trials so the prospective students can be tested for admission.
The entrance is in the top left of #m875000101#.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered a torn piece of black fabric at the end of the Path of Trials. Yet, outsiders could have no way of knowing where that is... More evidence that points to a traitor on the inside.
